review: The burger was absolutely delicious — crispy on the outside, juicy inside. Best I've had in years!
Staff were incredibly rude. I waited 10 minutes just to be acknowledged at the counter.
Restrooms were filthy. There was mold around the sink and paper towels all over the floor.
Delivery took over 90 minutes and the food arrived completely cold. Very disappointing.
The price is way too high for what you get. Totally overpriced for mediocre food.
Great flavor on the pasta, but the portion size was tiny for the cost.
Queue was enormous — we waited almost an hour before being seated. Unacceptable on a weekday.
Excellent customer service! The server was attentive, friendly, and made great recommendations.
Our order was completely wrong. Asked for no onions and got extra onions. Wrong item delivered.
The dining area was spotless and the tables were cleaned immediately after guests left. Impressive.
Loved the fresh aroma of the bread. The croissants were perfectly buttery and flaky.
The cashier was dismissive and unprofessional. Made us feel unwelcome the whole time.
Packaging was damaged when it arrived — the box was crushed and the product inside broken.
Super fast service! We were seated, ordered, and eating within 15 minutes. Impressive.
The salmon tasted stale. I'm fairly certain it wasn't fresh. Not going back.
Reasonable prices for the quality you get. Good value for money overall.
Waited 45 minutes for a simple sandwich. The kitchen seemed completely disorganised.
The hygiene here is shocking. I saw a cockroach near the kitchen entrance.
Pizza was soggy and undercooked. The dough wasn't cooked through at all.
Friendly host, great ambiance, and the host remembered our names from a previous visit!
Delivery driver left the package outside in the rain without ringing the bell. Everything got wet.
The steak was perfectly cooked — medium rare exactly as I asked. Incredible flavour.
I was charged twice for the same item. Had to argue for 20 minutes to get a refund.
The place was tidy and well-organised. Even the bathroom smelled clean.
Manager was great — came over personally to check on us and fix a mix-up quickly.
The fries were greasy and cold. The burger was burnt. Really poor quality today.
My tracking said delivered but the package never showed up. Terrible delivery service.
Good portion sizes and the value is fantastic. Will definitely come back.
The soup was bland and tasteless. No seasoning at all. Very disappointing.
Waiter ignored our table for 25 minutes. Had to get up and ask for the menu ourselves.
Love the seasonal menu changes! The new tacos are absolutely amazing — best in the city.
Staff at the bar were very helpful and explained every cocktail on the menu with enthusiasm.
The restroom was out of soap and had no paper towels. Basic hygiene standards not met.
The dessert was heavenly — chocolate lava cake with perfectly melted centre. Outstanding!
Missing two items from my delivery order. The driver didn't even wait for me to check.
Very reasonable prices — you get much more than you pay for. Great deal.
Long wait but completely worth it. The food quality made up for the delay.
Rude staff and a long wait. Double problem. Won't be returning.
Sticky tables and dusty chairs. The place clearly hasn't been deep-cleaned in weeks.
The chicken tikka masala was rich, creamy, and perfectly spiced. Absolutely loved it.
Package arrived three days late with no tracking updates whatsoever.
Incredibly friendly and welcoming team. They went above and beyond to make us feel special.
Food was cold and stale — clearly it had been sitting under a heat lamp too long.
The whole restaurant was filthy. Grease on every surface. Health hazard.
Got a prompt text when my order shipped and it arrived the next day. Fantastic delivery!
Priced well above every competitor nearby. Can't justify eating here regularly.
The wait was long but the staff kept us updated and brought complimentary bread. Nice touch.
Undercooked chicken — I sent it back twice and it was still pink in the middle. Dangerous.
The sushi was fresh, beautifully presented, and the flavours were outstanding.
Server was extremely attentive and even recommended a wine pairing that was perfect.
Wrong order delivered AGAIN. This is the third time. Beyond frustrating.
The place smells amazing the moment you walk in. Food is consistently excellent.
Completely overpriced — paid premium price for fast-food quality.
Waited over an hour with no update. Had to cancel and leave without eating.
The table was sticky and the menus had visible food stains. Not acceptable.
Quick, efficient, and the food was piping hot when it arrived. Exactly what you want.
The waffle was crispy outside and fluffy inside — just the right amount of sweetness.
Staff member rolled their eyes when I asked to modify my order. Very rude attitude.
Excellent value for a family dinner — fed four people well for under $60.
The lasagna was dry and tasteless. Not even close to what the menu description promised.
Driver called me to confirm my address — very professional. Package arrived in perfect condition.
Mold on the bathroom walls. This place should be reported to health authorities.
Reasonably priced for the area and the food quality matches the cost.
The line moved so slowly. Staff seemed confused and understaffed during the lunch rush.
